cardiac-output-range.label: Cardiac output at rest and at maximal exercise
cardiac-output-range.value: about 5 L·min⁻¹ at rest; at max about 20 L·min⁻¹ in untrained young men and 35–40 L·min⁻¹ in elite male endurance athletes (women about 15–30 L·min⁻¹)

hrmax-prediction.label: Age-predicted maximal heart rate
hrmax-prediction.value: 208 − 0.7 × age (Tanaka); the standard error of estimate is about 11 beats·min⁻¹
